title: Simple Starter Kits
description: Yet another mod that adds a starter kit
body:
Simple Starter Kits

It pretty much is what you think it is. This mod awards players with a configurable set of items on first world join aka. a starter kit.

The syntax for the .toml format looks something like this starterItems = ["minecraft:wooden_sword", "minecraft:leather_helmet", "minecraft:leather_boots", "minecraft:apple 16"]

You can also give the player items from other mods. Then it is "modid:itemname"
